text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that jumps straight to the main content, because this allows users with screen readers or keyboards to bypass unnecessary navigation and get to the important stuff quickly. This decision prioritizes usability for users with disabilities over the potential visual clutter of an extra link. By accepting the trade-off of slightly more complex page layout, we ensure that everyone can access the main content easily. This decision aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, particularly those who rely on keyboard navigation or screen readers.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast skip link fails users who rely on screen readers when the page reloads or route changes—focus jumps unpredictably, breaking context. Instead, pair it with `aria-live="polite"` on `<main>` so screen readers announce arrival without forcing focus. Settle it with testing: run a screen-reader session where the skip link triggers a route change—if the announcement is clear and focus lands smoothly, it’s good.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a persistent skip link that appears only when keyboard focus reaches the top of the page, styled in high contrast, and make it jump to `<main role="main">` with `aria-live="polite"` on `<main>` to announce arrival without stealing focus. This keeps navigation predictable for screen reader users while ensuring the skip link is always available when needed. The trade-off is a slightly more complex implementation to avoid focus chaos, but it guarantees reliability across page loads and route changes.

name: Reader
text: A persistent skip link that only appears on keyboard focus risks trapping users who tab too fast—they’ll miss it entirely. Instead, pair a high-contrast skip link *always visible* with `aria-live="polite"` on `<main>` to avoid surprise focus jumps. Settle it with Playwright tests simulating screen reader navigation and keyboard-only users.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Add a **high-contrast skip link always visible at page top** that jumps to `<main role="main" aria-live="polite">`; result: a tested, keyboard/screen-reader-friendly skip link; owner: accessibility-w1.
